notes.title: Smoke & Mirrors Content Update Hotfix
notes.content: [p]Greetings, Magicians and Technologists![/p][p]Earlier this month, we released the anticipated [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2458310/announcements/detail/532104287190253682?snr=2___"]Smoke & Mirrors Update[/url] that added tons of new content! We've learned, however, that some of you were unable to access this content because of its collision with the Child Labour questline.[/p][p]That’s why we've prepared a hotfix that makes the new content accessible for everyone after reaching certain point of the game, even if you’ve already completed the Child Labour questline. All you have to do is download the update through your Steam client.[/p][p]Thank you very much for your patience![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2458310/announcements/detail/532104287190253682?snr=2___"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New Arc Line | Smoke & Mirrors Update Is Out Now!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/90f573e703cfdc21570155d711edd0185d5fd6cd.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Magicians and Technologists![/p][p]It's a wonderful day today, as there's plenty of great news to share! Let's start off easy – along with TactiCon's start at 7PM CEST, July 17, New Arc Line will be [b]discounted by 20%[/b] for the whole duration of the event. Hopefully you managed to catch your breath after the Steam Summer Sale![/p][p][/p][p]Now to the core of today's message – [b]the anticipated [i]Smoke & Mirrors [/i]Content Update is out NOW[/b]![/p][previewyoutube="VtKwZ04ern4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Introducing the Dwarves![/b][/p][p]New Arc Line’s first major Content Updates introduces dwarves as a new playable race: Tough, stubborn and built like brick walls, dwarves are natural-born crafters with a deep bond to stone, steel and the arcane – and bring with them two new playable classes: the Hellfire Mage and Steam Mechanic!

[b]Hellfire Mage: Dwarven class[/b][/p][p]Unleash pure chaos with the most brutal school of magic yet! The Hellfire Mage channels dark, burning energies into devastating attacks – it’s a dangerous path for those who dare to walk it, but one that leads to the most destructive arcane powers known to the world. 

Hellfire Occultists invoke searing flames and summon demonic forces straight onto the battlefield. They're not the type to flinch from danger or try to negotiate first – they thrive on destruction. Wielding heavy maces, morning stars and similar vicious weapons, these warlocks back up their infernal spells with raw physical might, making sure that if their fire can't get the job done, a crushing blow will. In the eyes of a Hellfire Occultist, might makes right, the ends justify the means, and mercy is for the weak.
[/p][p][b]Steam Mechanic: Dwarven class[/b][/p][p]The Steam Mechanic, meanwhile, is a true Juggernaut of Invention. These wily creators tackle every challenge head-on, relying on roaring, coal-powered engines as well as their iron-like willpower. With gear powered by steam and raw ingenuity, they enhance the strength and resilience of their bodies. With each new piece of equipment, they become more and more of a walking fortress. [/p][p]The most adept Mechanics eventually assemble and pilot full steam-driven exoskeletons - towering machines built to smash, crush, and survive anything the world throws at them. When muscle meets machinery, nothing can stand in their way. If you choose the path of a Steampunk Mechanic, prepare to blend technological tradition and innovation, engineering prowess and a sharp tactical mind to fully utilize the many ingenious gadgets at your disposal.[/p][p]These classes are currently exclusive to the Dwarves, but will become available to all races through subsequent updates. 
[/p][p][b]New Questline[/b][/p][p]This update also takes you on an all-new adventure with the introduction of the "Step Behind the Curtain" questline, which will whisk you away to a new location – the Sacred Tree. On your journey, you will have the opportunity to meet a mysterious new friend – who will prove to be important in future updates![/p][p]

[/p][p]Those would be the most important additions to the world of New Arc, the whole Change Log can be found below the article.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Now a bit of economical news – as New Arc Line grows bigger and gets closer to the full launch, we will be adjusting its price to [b]24,99 EUR/24,99 USD/20,99 GBP[/b]. The price change will happen AFTER TactiCon, so you still have time to get New Arc Line for the great price with the aforementioned discount.[/p][p][/p][p]And that's it for today! Thank you for being such a supportive community, we hope you enjoy the [i]Smoke & Mirrors [/i]update at least as much as we do! Come join our [url="https://discord.gg/enAVFHEANh"]Discord[/url], have a chat with the community and share your feedback.[/p][p]And if you really enjoy the update, there is no better place to leave your thoughts than in a positive review here on Steam. These, as little as they might seem, help us to move on through the Early Access period and the feedback is invaluable.
[/p][p]Thank you![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Change Log:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tweaked camera assist behavior when zooming[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash during map transition in the Runaway Train quest[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stuttering/freezing during gameplay and combat[/p][/*][*][p]Improved localization polish across multiple languages[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the Unrestricted Voodoo Chest couldn’t be equipped with trousers[/p][/*][*][p]Improved save/load system support for older save data[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where skills could exceed 100[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled grenades from appearing in loot for mages[/p][/*][*][p]Updated quest rewards for completed quests[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing action point indicator in ability tooltips[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Notification, Magic Skill Check, and React widget UI[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New Arc Line: A New Magical Adventure Begins Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/90f573e703cfdc21570155d711edd0185d5fd6cd.png[/img]
Greetings, Magicians and Technologists!

Today we bring exciting news for all travelers to New Arc - the first major Early Access update is just around the corner, bringing fresh content, new characters, and thrilling gameplay possibilities!

[h3]Discover a New Magical Location[/h3]
Venture into a brand-new enchanted area, full of hidden mysteries and powerful magic. Brave the unknown and uncover what lies beyond the veil as you explore the Mages' Enclave!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/ed6515ded311eccf41f1d9f3ab672a86269f503c.png[/img]

[h3]New Playable Race: Dwarves [/h3]
Step into the world anew and observe it through the eyes of a Dwarf character - a race known for their iron will and unmatched craftsmanship, it is these attributes that allow them to excel in many fields of both magic and technology. While they can become proficient in all the various disciplines, in this update, we are starting them off with the two most typical classes for their race, taking advantage of the dwarves' innate strength and resilience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/0dc28d43700c95d355d40a0789f5e55b52e0b2e7.png[/img]

[h3]New Playable Classes for Dwarves*: Steampunk and Hellfire [/h3] 
[list]
[*] [b]Steampunk Mechanic[/b]: True Juggernauts of Invention. Steam Mechanics tackle every challenge head-on, relying on roaring, coal-powered engines as well as their iron-like willpower. With gear powered by steam and raw ingenuity, they enhance the strength and resilience of their bodies. With each new piece of equipment, they become more and more of a walking fortress. The most adept Mechanics eventually assemble and pilot full steam-driven exoskeletons — towering machines built to smash, crush, and survive anything the world throws at them. When muscle meets machinery, nothing can stand in their way. If you choose the path of a Steampunk Mechanic, prepare to blend technological tradition and innovation, engineering prowess and a sharp tactical mind to fully utilize the many ingenious gadgets at your disposal. 
[*] [b]Hellfire Occultist[/b]: Channeling dark, burning energies into devastating attacks - a dangerous path for those who dare to walk it, but one that leads to the most destructive arcane powers known to the world. Unleash pure chaos with the most brutal school of magic yet. Hellfire Occultists invoke searing flames and summon demonic forces straight onto the battlefield. They're not the type to flinch from danger or try to negotiate first - they thrive on destruction. Wielding heavy maces, morning stars and similar vicious weapons, these warlocks back up their infernal spells with raw physical might, making sure that if their fire can't get the job done, a crushing blow will. In the eyes of a Hellfire Occultist, might makes right, the ends justify the means, and mercy is for the weak.
[/list]
*all classes will become available for all races by the time the game leaves Early Access
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/62f0a4884b7dc7794cdc3e32c33977d0c72b9c92.jpg[/img]

[h3]Meet a New Companion[/h3]
In this update, you'll meet a new potential party member. She's... A kind of an elf. And practices a kind of voodoo magic. Her name is Claudia, and following her story will open up whole new dimensions of reality you never knew existed. You just better hope she’s in a good mood, though. Already intrigued? Good! We will bring you more details about this enigmatic new personality soon.

This update opens up new gameplay avenues in New Arc Line, offering players fresh ways to explore, fight, and weave their own story; whether they’re drawn to ancient magic or modern mechanical marvels.

P.S. A mischievous Gnome Trickster, in a distinct bright green suit will make his way to the city - care to speculate what happens when you meet him?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/1aa23e05e38491ee443472794b7431ff7851dac1.jpg[/img]

Thank you everyone who has already embarked on the journey to New Arc in the Early Access version of the game - we are truly grateful and we keep reading all your feedback and wonderful suggestions; we are always thinking about how to implement them! Make sure to keep them coming either here in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2458310/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url], or better yet, on the official [url=https://discord.gg/enAVFHEANh]New Arc Line Discord server[/url].

If you would like to support the game's development further, the best way is to post a review of it here on Steam. And if you prefer waiting for the game's full release, that's perfectly fine as well - we just recommend that you wishlist and follow it, so you don't miss any news about the project!

Until next time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/

notes.title: New Arc Line | Localization Patch Is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/90f573e703cfdc21570155d711edd0185d5fd6cd.png[/img]
Greetings, Magicians and Technologists!

Allow us to introduce you to the first pack of localizations of the New Arc Line worlds! In this first pack, we've localized the game into [b]Ukrainian, Russian and Simplified Chinese[/b]. We are currently working on the other promised translation - namely German - and we should be able to deliver it during the upcoming months. French and Spanish are planned for the full launch. We are looking into options of bringing these earlier as well, but cannot promise that just yet.

Along with the localizations, we're also bringing a handful of bugfixes and optimizations. The whole Change Log can be found below the article.

If you're still hesitating to get yourself a copy of New Arc Line, now's the perfect time to do so, as the game is discounted by 15%, starting today.

We would also like to express our unending gratitude to every single one of you! Thank you for playing New Arc Line and supporting us during our Early Access journey. You are most welcome to [url=https://discord.gg/enAVFHEANh]join our Discord server[/url] where you can chat and hang out with the other members of our community.

[h3][b]Change Log:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Equipped items tooltip comparison now works when SHIFT is pressed
[*] Changed Controls Menu Setting
[*] Level optimisation [Harbor Slums]
[*] Polishing widgets adaptation for localizations
[*] Blocked input of special symbols when saving or creating a character
[*] Fixed Automaton is still present on the map and available for interact after completing the objective "Sell The Automaton's location"
[*] Fixed Missing search zone after dialogue with Earl [Harbor Slums]
[*] Fixed Crowoman is floating in the air after completing the quest [Arrival Port]
[*] Fixed Player stuck in dialogue window if interact with greengrocer before dialogue with bandits / combat starts [Harbor Slums]
[*] Fixed Incorrect music in the background of the dialogue MQ00
[*] Implemented separation jingle for items appearing implementation
[*] Fixed in the brothel, its own soundtrack plays, and at some time, the standard background music can be turned on, creating a cacophony of two different melodies.
[*] Fixed: Localization issues in DEU
[/list]

notes.title: New Arc Line: The Art of Spellcraft
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/90f573e703cfdc21570155d711edd0185d5fd6cd.png[/img]
Greetings, Magicians and Technologists!

Your wish is our command, and based on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2458310/view/545601771364420154]poll we ran recently[/url], you have chosen an in-depth look at the [i][b]Spell Crafting System[/b][/i] as the topic of this article. However, before we dive into the lore and gameplay mechanics surrounding this staple of New Arc Line, we would like to announce that the works on the language update we have mentioned previously are progressing at a steady pace - and we will bring Ukrainian, German, Russian and Simplified Chinese subtitles to the game in April, along with some much requested bugfixes and quality of life improvements. And not too long after that, we plan to finalize and release the first Content Update; more details about that coming soon. For now, let's talk about...

[h2]Spellcrafting in the World of New Arc Line[/h2]

Magic and technology in our world currently exist out of balance, with technological progress [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2458310/announcements/detail/4686648306944236080]gradually eroding established traditions[/url]. After the creation of the Barrier by Reus, magic [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2458310/view/4688899473260625095]became strictly limited[/url].

However, mages refuse to give in and abandon their power completely - they can still remember what it was like to rule the world. In places where magic accumulates in great concentrations, the Barrier weakens, creating [b][i]reality rifts[/i][/b] - unstable areas offering a brief glimpse beyond the Barrier's thin veil, allowing mages to hear whispers from the other side. 

Those proficient in the arcane arts can try to listen, recognize and remember magical words emanating from such rifts. These tears in reality are a fleeting occurrence however - once the Barrier senses an attempt to breach it, it instantly seals the rupture. Thus, the knowledge a mage acquires depends on their experience: the more skilled they are, the more magical words they can perceive, comprehend and recall. The size of a rift, or the thinning of reality’s fabric, also depends on the power of the rituals and spells that caused it to manifest.

This is how the art of Spellcraft emerges - the creation and modification of spells using magical knowledge gleaned from beyond the Barrier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/2a2463855334738ac822f8470f923ccaafd3693f.png[/img]

Beyond the magical Barrier dwell the [i][b]Weavers[/b][/i] - mysterious [b][i]All-Shapers[/i][/b], whose words once had the power to reshape reality itself, who ruled unopposed during the era of the Magical Empire. Each of them crafted the world as they envisioned it - and their words, infused with deep meaning, form the foundation of all spells. Those who can understand their essence can weave spells, much like prayers to the All-Shapers, to imbue them with power.

[h3]The Risks and Power of Spellcraft[/h3]

Interacting with rifts, like practicing any powerful magic, carries great risks. Before the Barrier was erected, mages could reshape reality at will, often transforming even themselves in the process, to align with their goals and visions. The strongest among them could ascend and become the fabled Weavers, All-Shapers.

After the Barrier was established, mages who attempt to wield excessive power still undergo transformations - but since reality itself no longer changes with them, they are not in control of the process and gradually turn into monsters. 

The more knowledge a mage gains, the more powerful they become - both in terms of creating new spells and enchanting their equipment. But as their power grows, so does the need for caution when wielding it, less they completely change into the monstrous [i][b]Abhorred[/b][/i].

[h3]The Last Hope of Magic[/h3]

In a world where magic is but a fading remnant of past greatness and studying it has become an act of defiance, and a risky one at that, Spellcraft is not just an art form - it is a means of survival of a whole culture, a path to reclaiming lost power.

The All-Shapers beyond the Barrier also reject the current world order and seek to restore their dominion. They are eager to grant ambitious mages powerful spells, hoping they will halt technological progress. And if a few seekers of magic turn into monsters along the way, it is a small price to pay.
After all, what is the fate of a single mage when the very fabric of reality is at stake?

[h3]How does this work in the game?[/h3]

Peering into a reality rift, a mage hears whispers of the Weavers, their thoughts and ideas. These words manifest as cards, which the player can combine to create spells and enchant items. Spells can be crafted anywhere, as the process occurs entirely within a mage's mind and has no visible effect on the world around them. It does however require a great deal of concentration.

There are three categories of magical cards:
[list]
[*] Element
[*] Form
[*] Modifier
[/list]
Each card also has a Shape (circle, square, or triangle) noted on it; only cards bearing the same symbol can be combined together. Some cards may even be marked with two shapes, making them more versatile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/92393967a1596824ea67075a6c2f7778acdb4151.png[/img]

[h3]Spellcrafting[/h3]

To create a spell, the player must combine three different cards, all with matching shapes - an Element card, a Form card, and a Modifier card. New spells significantly increase a mage’s power, granting access to stronger and more diverse magical abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/f48a824d2c44a7f1d66ae671c3be523fffb488d5.png[/img]

[h3]Enchanting Items[/h3]

Item enchantment works similarly to spellcrafting, with one key difference: the Form card is replaced by the item itself. This means that enchanting an item requires two cards - an Element and a Modifier. Enchanted items greatly enhance the mage’s magical potential, increasing their power and combat efficiency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/e7766f5874e345865abdbfbcb5e860864cc4bab2.png[/img]

[h3]Spellcrafting in Early Access[/h3]

Currently, the game features 9 Element cards (3 for each of the planned mage classes), 3 Form cards, and 6 Modifier cards. While we do not plan to change the principles of the system during New Arc Line's Early Access period, we will be expanding it by introducing new cards, magical words our arcane-inclined players will have a chance to learn in the reality rifts they encounter - so you can look forward to a greater variety of spells, abilities and enchantments!

What do you think about this aspect of the game? Let us know here in the comments, in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2458310/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url], but the absolutely best place to do so is the [url=https://discord.gg/enAVFHEANh]New Arc Line Discord server[/url], where you can chat with other fans as well as the devs!

Thank you everyone who has already embarked on the journey to New Arc in the Early Access version of the game - we are truly grateful and we keep reading all your feedback and wonderful suggestions; we are always thinking about how to implement them! If you would like to support the game's development further, the best way is to post a review of it here on Steam. And if you prefer waiting for the game's full release, that's perfectly fine as well - we just recommend that you wishlist and follow it, so you don't miss any news about the project!

Until next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/90f573e703cfdc21570155d711edd0185d5fd6cd.png[/img]
Greetings, Magicians and Technologists!

While we don’t have a game update ready for you just yet, our team is working tirelessly on new content, and we would like to give you a small glimpse of what's to come to New Arc Line, and shed a bit of light on some aspects of our development process. So first, we will take a look at new character design, then we will talk briefly about localizations and supporting different languages, and last but not least, we will have a small piece of news about our community activities. So let's dive right in, shall we?

[h3]New Characters and Monsters in the World of New Arc Line[/h3]
We are creating unique characters that will become part of an exciting adventure. These include new companions, quest characters of various races and classes, and, of course, dangerous enemies that you will have to face.

Character creation is a complex and fascinating process, which can be divided into several stages. First we begin with the narrative aspect, defining the character's backstory, motivation, and place in the game's world. Then, artists create concept art, visualizing the look and personality of the future hero. Once the concept is approved, 3D modeling begins, bringing the character to life with form, textures, and details. Designers also work on combat mechanics, unique abilities, and visual effects for monsters, ensuring that battles are dynamic and memorable. Finally, animation specialists bring the character to life by creating movement sets that define their behavior. This comprehensive process allows us to create truly unique and unforgettable characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/4bcc5495eb00221b327e1dc94ac8f4b5e9c913c4.png[/img]

In the second act of the game, you will encounter one of New Arc Line’s most terrifying and mysterious monsters. This horrifying form is not just some creature spawned from darkness, but the result of a tragic fate. Before you stands a woman who once possessed an important artifact, which is tied to your hero’s destiny. When we meet her in her new form, new secrets of the world will be revealed, including the mechanics of one of its most crucial elements - Reality Shards. What led her to this transformation? What secrets do these shards hold? You will have a chance to find those answers (and more) on your journey soon.

[h3]New Languages Coming to the Game[/h3]

We are also actively working on the localization of the game to make New Arc Line more accessible and enjoyable for everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/7a2bd2ceb7d772207a8353cd4d9d764b995acd5f.jpg[/img]

We worked out a process with our translators, which will allow us to localize the current version of the game to most of our planned languages, and keep those translations even through the coming updates. Therefore, very soon, you will be able to play New Arc Line not only in English, but also with Ukrainian, German, Russian or Simplified Chinese subtitles. We aim to ensure that every player can fully immerse themselves in the world, enjoy the story, and experience the gameplay in their preferred language.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/73b20542104aa402d713cd66f1c82fd2a5f830c7.png[/img]

We would like to make this kind of "Development News" article into a recurring series, bringing you information about the state of development regularly. If you would like that, please let us know here in the comments, or even better, come join the New Arc Line Discord server. But that's not all - we also plan to keep producing "Dev Diary" articles, shedding light on some of the game's lore and mechanics, the way we did so far for:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2458310/announcements/detail/4480613701830836615]The Legend of Mick Mortinssen[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2458310/announcements/detail/4686648306944236080]The Bright Future of Technology[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2458310/announcements/detail/4688899473260625096]The Brief History of Magic[/url]
and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2458310/announcements/detail/4354502761453974420]The Iron Plague Explained[/url]


We have a few topics in mind, but we would like you to choose what interests you the most. And so we once again invite everyone to join the aforementioned [url=https://discord.com/invite/MCAYysT7N9]New Arc Line Discord server[/url], as that is where we are holding the poll to decide that RIGHT NOW - you can vote until Monday, March 3, when the survey closes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/62950fd45861d00fbcc6af4f7c93db7bece80f2c.jpg[/img]

Thank you everyone who has already embarked on the journey to New Arc in the Early Access version of the game - we are truly grateful and we keep reading all your feedback and wonderful suggestions, we are always thinking about how to implement them! If you would like to support the game's development further, the best way is to post a review of it here on Steam. And if you prefer waiting for the game's full release, that's perfectly fine as well - we just recommend that you wishlist and follow it, so you don't miss any news about the project!

Until next time!

notes.title: New Arc Line | First Early Access Patch is Live Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, Magicians and Technologists!

We are delighted to let you know that the first patch for New Arc Line that we promised you has now gone live! Please note that this is not yet one of the big, Early Access Content updates, although we are already working on that too; and we will soon share more detailed info about the new classes, companions, quests and other content and changes you can look forward to (and when to expect them). However, we have been able to bring several heavily requested features, improvements and fixes, as well as a bunch of smaller ones into the game already.

Among the highlights are improvements to the save game system, which also improve performance and remove stuttering caused by having too many saves; adding separate volume control sliders for SFX and music; improved path-finding for Mick, so he doesn't get stuck; fixed many visual and other bugs, and also added a more convenient way to send us logs when the game crashes, making future bugfixing easier for us. We have also made small improvements to the way the world reacts to player choices, which is something we will focus much more on throughout Early Access. You can read the full Change Log at the end of this article.

We would like to thank all our players for the support and feedback we've received so far! It is truly heart-warming to know that you enjoy the game and that you care about it; please keep sending us your bug reports, suggestions and ideas. You can do so here on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2458310/discussions/]Steam in the Discussions[/url], but the best way is to join the [url=https://discord.gg/enAVFHEANh]New Arc Line Discord server[/url], where you can chat with other fans as well as the devs!

There is one more reason for us to celebrate - you have voted us into the Top 100 Indies of the Year on IndieDB! We are at the very beginning of our Early Access journey and we understand there is a lot of work ahead of us to make New Arc Line worthy of any higher praise; but we encourage everyone to browse through the [url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2024-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100]Top 100 list[/url] and vote for your favorites - it's a great way to support indie developers and discover new and interesting games!

[h3]Full Change Log:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a reporting button for crashes (the ability to send logs easier)
[*] Added the option to continue playing after completing the Early Access part of the main quest
[*] Added separate control sliders for SFX and Music volume
[*] Added the dialog log, players will be able to see the whole active conversation
[*] Better organized save files
[*] Fixed stuttering in save/load menu when player has too many saves

[*] Added a skill Check for drunkard in a bar
[*] Added more load screen images
[*] Added the health risks warning for GSPR compliance
[*] Fixed getting stuck in the environment for the player
[*] Fixed Mick getting stuck
[*] Fixed Mage Corruption window not closing after pressing 'Esc' button
[*] Fixed Z-fighting textures on the walls in the Orphanage Basement
[*] Fixed Z-fighting textures on the windows, walls and objects in the Orphanage
[*] Fixed Clipping issue on Costume of Masculinity
[*] Fixed textures on a character’s hairstyle
[*] Fixed Punching enemies causes blood to almost completely paint them red except for the face
[*] Fixed Items disappearing from the inventory
[*] Fixed Basic Voodoo Jacket's visual bug
[*] Fixed A placeholder string is in the dialogue option for the fisherman
[*] Fixed Character skills bad icon
[*] Fixed The 'Serial Catcaller' achievement can be obtained without interacting with cats
[*] Fixed "Scrap Metal Capitalist" achievement is not unlocked after selling / disassembling automaton
[*] Fixed "Pied Piper" achievement could progress by rats in dead state after load of saved game
[/list]

Until next time!

notes.content:
Greetings, Magicians and Technologists!

It's been a week since New Arc Line launched into Early Access and the support and feedback we've received has been tremendous so far! Thank you very much, it is truly heart-warming to know that you enjoy the game and that you care about it; which you keep showing us by letting us know what should be fixed, changed and improved. Based on that, we are already hard at work on a quality-of-life patch that we hope to have out before the Holidays, but we cannot firmly promise that at this point - New Arc Line is not a small game and we want to test every update thoroughly rather than risk releasing a version that would not be enjoyable to play.

Among the features and improvements we plan to bring in this upcoming patch are:
[list]
[*] Separate sliders for SFX and Music volume controls.
[*] The ability to continue exploring the world even after the main quest has been completed.
[*] The ability to read through the entire currently active dialogue (including previous replies).
[*] Bug-reporting tool inside the game, to streamline the fixing process.

[/list]
This is not a complete list, we are working on other additions as well, but we are also still evaluating what is realistic to finalize and properly test before the Holidays.

There is also a Holiday tradition for indie games: the annual IndieDB Indie of the Year Awards, and 2024 is no exception. You can now vote for all your favorite indie games on the site and select the Top100 - this round of voting will close on December 10, and voting for the prestigious Top10 will begin a day after that. We therefore humbly ask you to consider voting for New Arc Line - all you have to do to is [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/new-arc-line]follow this link[/url] and click [b]VOTE NOW[/b]. It's that simple, no registration or e-mail verification is needed; so you can tell your friends to do the same!

notes.title: New Arc Line is Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/90f573e703cfdc21570155d711edd0185d5fd6cd.png[/img]
Greetings, Magicians and Technologists!

A most auspicious day has come, your ship has finally docked at the port in the New World! Are you ready for your journey to the city of New Arc and become the first to find a cure for the Iron Plague? Will you join the side of Technology or Magic?

[previewyoutube=AXy0JpZVPeg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]State of the Game[/h2]

Now, before you rush off to make your fortune, it is important to note that the game is launching into Early Access - you will not be able to complete your hero's story yet. We are grateful beyond measure to all who decide to support us and join us on the development journey. We will do our best to listen to all your feedback, suggestions, and criticism - please let us know your thoughts about the game either here in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2458310/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url], or even better, join us on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/MCAYysT7N9]New Arc Line Discord server[/url]!

In the Early Access Launch version of New Arc Line, you will get to experience around a quarter of the main story, and a third of the overall content we plan for the game - depending on your chosen difficulty and playstyle, it should take you around 10-12 hours to explore it. You will meet and be able to join up with 3 companion characters, each with their unique storyline, and you yourself will be able to create your own character as either a Diesel Engineer or a Voodoo Shaman and either a Human or an Elf.

[h2]Early Access Development Plans[/h2]

One of the main areas we want to focus on is the optimization and technical state of the game. Based on various benchmarks and early feedback we've received, we have managed to improve it noticeably since last month’s demo. But we need your help to improve the optimization even further - if you experience framerate drops or any other performance issues, please share as many details about your PC, where in the game it happened, how long you've been playing, what was the framerate at the time, etc. This will help us tremendously in making the gameplay experience as smooth as possible.

Of course, we plan to release several large content updates throughout the Early Access period, bringing new quests, companions, classes, abilities, and gear. We do have an internal schedule set up for these, and we look forward to being able to share that with you in the near future. We absolutely expect our plans will need to change based on your feedback - that is the whole purpose of Early Access, after all!

[h2]The Full Release[/h2]

The game’s largest update will come with the full release, which we estimate to take about a year to achieve - besides new playable races, abilities, spells, and crafting recipes, quests, and locations, we also plan to add various new gameplay systems and features - the subclass system to further customize your characters, a hub for you to hang out in and of course, the ability to romance your companions. Naturally, you will be able to complete the main story from the start to its multiple endings, depending on your choices.

We cannot thank you enough for your support, whether you decide to buy the Early Access launch version and dive into the world of New Arc Line right away, or just wishlist and follow the game here on Steam to follow our development, we couldn't have made it this far without you.

Until next time!

notes.title: New Arc Line: The Bright Future of Technology!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/90f573e703cfdc21570155d711edd0185d5fd6cd.png[/img]

Greetings, Magicians and Technologists!
 
Previously, we have [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2458310/view/4688899473260625095]talked at length about the role of magic[/url] in New Arc Line, and it's high time we discussed the role technology plays in our world and its future. After all, imposing steam-powered exoskeletons, weird, crackling tesla-powered weapons or ultra-reliable diesel engines can be just as enchanting as any magical incantation! But not all in the world of New Arc Line is shiny and running like clockwork, despite the engineering and scientific elite ruling it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/2012c1ad196bfbcc315f6f66b8c40c1f68758e4b.png[/img]

[h3]The Rise of Technologists[/h3]
We will not repeat our history lecture about the [i]Weavers[/i] and [i]Reus the Lawbringer[/i] and how he made scientific progress possible - you can read all about it in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2458310/view/4688899473260625095]"A Brief History of Magic."[/url] Suffice to say, after the Mago-Technology wars, science and engineering became the ruling principles. This triumph catapulted the Technologists to power, and nothing stood in the way of industrialization and inventors becoming the new sorcerers, the ones shaping the world and society alike. Steamboats took over the seas, zeppelins conquered the skies and wands and magical staves were surpassed by guns, grenades and other technological implements of death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/9106a1a2846e0f21e03529025b44f45d08870193.png[/img]

[h3]Automatons' Revolution[/h3]
A recent invention kickstarted yet another paradigm shift - [i]Wayne Zindo[/i]'s breakthrough, the creation of automatons, didn't just cement his leadership among the Technologists - it transformed society as a whole. These efficient, low-cost machines can perform all kinds of tasks, from logging to babysitting, driving unprecedented economic growth. After all, automatons do not tire, falter or complain, and so they allow people to enjoy their lives, instead of toiling away in menial jobs. The innovation paved the way for Mr. Zindo to head the Eastern Technology Syndicate, which is at the heart of the action in New Arc Line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/b662d58c039d073bb52cea61c23392b13f35683c.png[/img]

[h3]The Downside of Progress[/h3]
But trouble is brewing beneath the surface. As you might have guessed, the rise of automatons has led to massive layoffs in industrial plants, leaving countless families without a source of income. Ironically, the very workers who once cheered for the suppression of mages are now being crushed by the wheels of the technological revolution they helped create. Industrialists still promise a bright future, and who knows - perhaps they will turn the world into a utopia in the end. But as of the beginning of the story of New Arc Line, the poor, the tired, the huddled masses still yearn to be free and it seems that one form of tyranny has simply replaced another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/53b5f6fe46f576ec781ff1324e7a3af19653b9dd.png[/img]

[h3]Never say die![/h3]
Nevertheless, talented enthusiasts can still make their dreams come true, even in this rapidly evolving world - if they show a real work ethic, that is! Opportunities abound in three technological areas in particular: Tesla, Diesel, and Steam. Each field requires a unique skillset from its practitioners, but gives them access to specialized weapons and equipment, granting powerful abilities on par with actual magic. In the game, this translates into the option to select out of three playable technological classes*:

[b]Diesel Engineer[/b]
Often seen sporting leather coats with many pockets and utility belts to store the tools they need for their constant tinkering, Diesel Engineers are experts in firearms and skilled creators of cutting-edge diesel gadgets - you never know when a Jetpack might come in handy to bail you out of a tight spot!

[b]Steam Mechanic[/b]
These are the most hands-on of the technological classes, preferring to face any problem and obstacle head-on. To that end, they utilize the awesome strength of highly reliable steam engines, powering wearable gear that enhances their own physical abilities; the most skilled Mechanics construct and operate full steam-powered exoskeletons, transforming into nigh-unstoppable behemoths when the need arises to bash some skulls in!

[b]Tesla Scientist[/b]
Practitioners of the most mysterious, almost ethereal of the technological disciplines can often be seen with strange, buzzing and sparkling instruments strapped to their bodies, nervously fidgeting as they strive to control lightning itself. The more superstitious folk would say that Tesla Scientists are playing with powers beyond their understanding that are better left alone, but the most accomplished of these scholars are rumored to be able to even reanimate lifeless bodies - what could go wrong?

[i]*Diesel Engineer will be available at Early Access launch, Steam Mechanic and Tesla Scientist will be added as playable classes later.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/4690d50978d17a9f9c449477e04a66de9f5ab41a.png[/img]

Thank you for joining us on another brief foray into the world of New Arc Line – we hope you enjoyed it! We cannot wait for you to dive into the game's world when we [b]launch into Early Access on November 26, 2024[/b] - stay tuned, don't forget to [b]wishlist & follow the game[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/]here on Steam[/url] and join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/MCAYysT7N9]New Arc Line Discord server[/url], so you stay up to date on all news and announcements! 

Until next time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588423/99ed0f9acc2fcbc0fb71d2127e380b0ab64aa0d9.png[/img]
